allowCustomValue.name: Allow Custom Value
allowCustomValue.description: Specify whether or not the ComboBox should allow a value that is not in the list to be entered in the input

autoAlign.name: Auto Align
autoAlign.description: Experimental: Will attempt to automatically align the floating element to avoid collisions.

decorator.name: Decorator
decorator.description: Experimental: Provide a decorator component to be rendered inside the ComboBox component

direction.name: Direction
direction.description: Specify the direction of the combobox dropdown.

disabled.name: Disabled
disabled.description: Specify if the control should be disabled, or not

helperText.name: Helper Text
helperText.description: Provide helper text that is used alongside the control label for additional help

invalid.name: Invalid
invalid.description: Specify if the currently selected value is invalid.

invalidText.name: Invalid Text
invalidText.description: Message which is displayed if the value is invalid.

placeholder.name: Placeholder
placeholder.description: Placeholder text before a user enters any input.

size.name: Size
size.description: Specify the size of the ListBox.

titleText.name: Title Text
titleText.description: Text used in the label element tied to the combobox.

typeahead.name: Typeahead
typeahead.description: Experimental: will enable autocomplete and typeahead for the input field

warn.name: Warn
warn.description: Specify whether the control is currently in warning state

warnText.name: Warn Text
warnText.description: Provide the text that is displayed when the control is in warning state
